row.evidence: Clockify's pricing page lists 'SCIM provisioning' under the Enterprise plan ($11.99 per seat/month billed annually), and the SCIM help article says the feature is for the Enterprise plan.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM, SSO and audit log are Enterprise-only ($11.99 per seat/month annual, $14.99 monthly); Basic $3.99 annual ($4.99 monthly), Standard $5.49, Pro $7.99; a CAKE.com Productivity Suite bundle ($12.99) includes Enterprise features. SCIM v2 via a generic endpoint (workspace URL + /scim/v2, bearer token) with documented setups for Okta (SCIM 2.0 Test App), Entra (non-gallery app) and JumpCloud (custom app); no vendor catalogue apps. SCIM syncs users and groups; enabling SCIM deletes existing Clockify groups and locks user and group management inside Clockify. Deactivated users do not occupy a paid seat. The REST API (X-Api-Key) is on every plan, but adding users via API needs a paid plan; the remove-user endpoint is deprecated.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: API available; adding users via API requires a paid subscription.

auth.token_source: Workspace settings > Authentication tab > Enable SCIM (Base URL and Bearer Token)

deprovision.data_retained: User status is set to deactivated in Clockify; deactivated users do not occupy a paid seat. GDPR order documented as Deactivate, Anonymize, Remove, with anonymizing done while the user is still assigned in the IdP.

attributes.notes: Docs name the synced fields (name, email, status, timezone) rather than SCIM attribute paths.

limitations.text: Enabling SCIM deletes existing Clockify groups (new group IDs); groups cannot be preloaded.
Once SCIM is on, admins can no longer add, update or delete users or groups inside Clockify.
Documented IdPs: JumpCloud, Okta and Microsoft Entra, all through generic SCIM apps.

capabilities.notes: Add user to workspace (invite); status update activates/deactivates; DELETE user endpoint is deprecated and not functional.

endpoints.purpose: Find all users on a workspace
Add user to a workspace (paid plans only)
Remove user from a workspace (deprecated, not functional)
Give manager role to a user

audit_log_api.notes: Plan taken from the pricing page's Audit log feature; the API reference does not state a plan for the endpoint.

rate_limits.text: 50 requests per second per add-on per workspace when using X-Addon-Token; no limit stated for X-Api-Key.

limitations.text: Adding users via API requires a paid subscription and is limited by paid seats.

okta.notes: https://www.okta.com/integrations/clockify/ returned 404; Clockify documents Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (clockify-tutorial 404); Clockify documents a non-gallery app.

google.notes: Clockify documents SAML and OIDC SSO with Google; no Google provisioning app found.

onelogin.notes: Clockify documents SAML SSO with OneLogin; SCIM with OneLogin is not documented.

jumpcloud.notes: Clockify documents a JumpCloud custom application with Identity Management (SCIM); JumpCloud's own page returned 403.
